areas: Serving the Greater St. Louis area

hero.h1: Lighting Control Installation in St. Louis
hero.sub: Light that follows the sun, keypads engraved for every room, and a color temperature you set once. Less to think about and a calmer home.

items.p: One keypad in each room, engraved with the scenes you use: Dinner, Movie, Goodnight. No wall of switches.
Warm light at dawn and dusk, bright at midday. Your lights keep pace with the day so your body keeps its rhythm.
Lights come on at dusk, off at bedtime, and dim when the movie starts. Away from home, the house keeps its routine.

about.p: Fusion Tech Companies serves the Greater St. Louis area with high-end electrical and media work for luxury homes, with over 25 years of combined experience. Our Union Local 1 technicians plan, wire, install, and program each system, and our team walks you through it once the work is done.

photos.alt: A dedicated home theater with lit wall sconces and a row of red seats
A kitchen with pendant lights over the island and a wall of windows
A bedroom with a lounge chair at a window over the city

steps.p: We meet with you and the homeowner, walk the plans, and settle what each room should do.
Drawings mark every keypad, fixture, and wire drop. Hardware and labor are listed in detail and reviewed with you before anything is ordered.
Wire at rough-in, trim and program at finish, on the construction schedule. Drawings are updated to as-built when the work is done.
As-built documents and the programming files are handed over at sign-off. Manufacturer warranties plus our workmanship warranty, and service for the life of the system.

services.p: Most lighting projects grow. These cover the rest of the house.

items.p: Music in every room, or just one, from your phone.
A room built for the screen, the sound, and lights that dim when the show begins.
Shades and drapes that move with the sun and with your lighting scenes.
Lights, shades, music, climate, and cameras from one keypad, remote, or app.
Cameras, access control, and monitoring for the whole property.
Power that stays on when the street goes dark.

items.q: Does lighting control work in an existing home, or only in a new build?
items.a: Both. A new build or remodel gets wired keypads at rough-in. An existing home can use wireless keypads and dimmers with no new wiring.

items.q: Can I keep my current fixtures?
items.a: Most of the time, yes. The dimmers sit behind the wall or in a panel. We check each fixture type, LED included, before we design.

items.q: What happens if the internet goes down?
items.a: The keypads and dimmers keep working. Only the app from outside the house needs the internet.

items.q: How do we change a scene later?
items.a: Ask us, or change it yourself from the app. A keypad can be re-engraved if a room's use changes.

items.q: Do you work with my builder, electrician, or designer?
items.a: Yes. Your electrician gets a wire plan, and keypad locations and finishes are set with your designer.

items.p: We had motorized dual shades by Alta installed on the first level of our home. We absolutely love them!

We have used Fusion for two major tech installs at two homes. They are great to work with. The team is not just  technically capable but very easy to work with, great communication and plain ole good guys.

My family did a huge home renovation project and new build addition that took 4 years and Fusion did a phenomenal job. Smart lighting, smart TVs, security system, and speaker systems with complicated cabling and setups all within one app.

final.p: Tell us about the home and we will set a time to talk.
